relations.subject: Robert Koldewey
relations.evidence: in January 1899, the Deutsche Orient-Gesellschaft sent out an expedition under the direction of Dr. Robert Koldewey, of Görlitz, assisted by the Assyriologist, Dr. Meissner, of Halle, and 'Regierungsbauführer' Andrae

relations.subject: Fulgence Fresnel
relations.evidence: During the years 1851-1854 the French expedition under Fulgence Fresnel and Jules Oppert collected on Tell Kasr, especially on its eastern side, a great many fragments of colored tiles.
